parallel.description: Whether to enable parallel processing. When set to false, all modules will use single-threading
parallel.max_workers_description: Global default maximum worker thread count, usually set to CPU core count or slightly higher. If not specified or null, system will automatically set to CPU core count (with upper and lower limits)

adaptive.enabled_description: Whether to enable adaptive thread allocation, dynamically adjusting thread count based on task type
adaptive.io_bound_factor_description: Thread factor for IO-intensive tasks (such as API calls). Since there's more IO waiting, usually set >1. Actual thread count = max_workers * io_bound_factor
adaptive.cpu_bound_factor_description: Thread factor for CPU-intensive tasks (such as graph rendering). Usually set <1 to reduce context switching overhead. Actual thread count = max_workers * cpu_bound_factor

parallel.default_workers_description: Default thread count for each module, can override global settings to allow each module to use thread count most suitable for its characteristics

default_workers.event_extraction_description: Event extraction: IO-intensive task with many API calls, suitable for more threads
default_workers.hallucination_refine_description: Hallucination refinement: IO-intensive task with many API calls, suitable for more threads
default_workers.causal_linking_description: Causal linking: Mixed task with both computation and API calls, uses standard thread count
default_workers.graph_builder_description: Graph builder: CPU-intensive task, mainly computation and rendering, suitable for fewer threads to reduce competition
